A two-block ritual cooking cauldron set over a hearth of soul embers and reinforced with Mysterious Stone. Used to brew §5Soul Stew§r.

§6Brewing Process§r
1. §eAdd Meat:§r Right-click the cauldron with any raw meat (beef, pork, mutton, chicken, etc.) to start the boil.
2. §6Simmer:§r The cauldron bubbles with soulfire for 5 seconds.
3. §aCollect:§r Right-click with an empty wooden bowl to scoop out your §5Soul Stew§r.

Right-click with an empty hand at any time to check its status on your action bar (Idle, Boiling, or Done).
Assembled from stripped logs, a campfire, a cauldron, and a base of §5Mysterious Stone§r.
